correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed deletion of a designated singleton and contraction of a pair: each marginal B_(n-1)/B_n, disjoint joint B_(n-2)/B_n and incident joint zero. Thus the exact rank-one-minus-two-permutation matrix follows entrywise. Strict Bell log convexity gives r>p^2, while Asai--Kubo--Kuo normalized Bell ratio bound r/p^2<=n/(n-1) makes the constant eigenvalue (n-2)r-np^2<0. Fourier diagonalization of P_d gives -r(1+exp(-2πimd/n)) at m!=0; zero iff md=n/2 mod n, having exactly gcd(n,d) solutions when n/gcd even. Independent exact partition enumeration and rational-matrix rank verifies all n=3..7 and displacements; it is not a proof for general n.
